bundleSizes.method: Production files on disk. Static imports and HTML module preloads define initial JavaScript; dynamic imports are excluded. Gzip each file independently with Bun.gzipSync at level 9, then sum. Exclude benchmark probes, source maps, HTML, fonts, images, documents and network framing. Whiteboard is the editor's static dependency closure minus initial JavaScript. Sizes describe emitted code, not browser network traces or service-worker cache traffic.

limitations: 9 normal reload/input samples,9 UI/live-peer samples,3 reconnect/large/multicursor samples. Descriptive p95 at these sample counts.

Visible-editor readiness requires expected source and an animation frame. It excludes fixture creation, setup/import and optional statistics completion; it is not complete-UI settlement or an uncached first download.

Fresh separate normal accounts have2/32/128KiB sources plus default welcome. Different welcome content remains. Large documents use separate accounts so their data/background work do not contaminate normal cells. Sources begin identical; measured edits grow different CRDT representation/history.
Normal local interaction samples precede main synced-account registration. Sync samples use a subsequently registered original account and passive profile clones; no keys or payloads are published.

128KiB UI samples use pointer activation. Missing2KiB cells were recovered once with keyboard activation; keep input modality distinct. Original native pointer required-state failures remain recorded. Main switching remains unmeasured.

Main1MiB seed command timed out35s, but exact1MiB source was recovered after reopening without re-import. Rewrite local-save gate exceeded its initial setup window but later pending0/busyfalse and exactsource were verified. Setup timings are excluded.
Main1MiB beginning input required-state deadline expired20s; middle was skipped. Valid reload/end cells are retained. These are unverified automation outcomes, not app-crash claims.
The trusted continuous probe is25 sequential native edits followed by3s of deferred/background observation, not sustained multi-second typing. Inter-input gaps are recorded.
Headless Chrome presents near60Hz. Callback/native timings do not include all layout/raster/compositor work. No universal120fps claim or proof of8.3ms complete frame budgets.
No fresh20+writer browser-frame stress or1MiB fenced-code case. Prior24writer module evidence is linked separately and is not a fresh capacity measurement.
Source/application unchanged during timings. Stable agent-browser daemon timeout20000ms for everycommand; launch or activation failures remain visible.
